title: Eliminating Dark Energy and Resolving the Hubble Tension via Linear Relativistic Cosmic Expansion
description: The standard cosmological model (Lambda-CDM) requires a dominant, fine-tuned dark energy component (Omega_Lambda approx 0.685) to explain late-time acceleration, while facing an acute 5-sigma Hubble constant tension. We demonstrate that Chronodynamic Relativity eliminates dark energy and resolves the Hubble tension through strictly linear cosmic expansion a(t) = t / t_0 coupled with proper time dilation eta(z) = (1+z)^(-n/2). Luminosity distance evaluates exactly to d_L(z) = (c / H_0) * (1+z) * ln(1+z). Confronted against 1,701 Pantheon+ Type Ia supernovae, linear expansion achieves chi^2/dof = 0.985 with zero free cosmological parameters, matching DESI 2024 BAO across all 7 redshift bins.
